model: YOLOv8s fine-tuned on RDD2022 India + Kaggle pothole (this repository's own run)

andrewmvd__pothole-detection.licence: Database Contents License (DbCL) v1.0, as stated in the description on the Kaggle page (sidebar field reads 'Other (specified in description)'), read 17-11-2026; credit the original authors: Make ML, Potholes Dataset, https://makeml.app/datasets/potholes

rdd2022_india.licence: CC BY 4.0 (figshare record 10.6084/m9.figshare.21431547.v1, licence field read from the figshare API on 17-11-2026)

selection_rule: best.pt = the epoch with the best Ultralytics validation fitness (0.1*mAP50 + 0.9*mAP50-95 over all classes), early stop after 25 epochs without gain; the test split is scored once, after the weights are fixed
selection_rule_as_recorded_by_trainer: best validation mAP50 on class 'pothole'; ties -> higher val mAP50-95; test scored once
serving_confidence_chosen_on: loader default; not tuned on any split
not_claimed: zebra crossings (a separate pretrained detector is used as published)
people and vehicles (a COCO-pretrained detector is used as published)
accuracy on bus-mounted video; the test photographs are public-repository images
box tightness beyond mAP@0.5:0.95 on the held-out test split

artefact_check.rule: ONNX test mAP@0.5 within 0.02 of best.pt, and the serving decoder recovers >= 90% of best.pt's boxes with >= 90% of its own matched (same class, IoU >= 0.5)

diagnostic_best_pt_cpu_batch1.note: best.pt scored with the same settings as the ONNX run (CPU, batch 1, test split), run by the team after the check failed; does not change the result

deployment_check_note: not run: python -m scripts.verify_rdd_detector --clean-roads (it runs only after the artefact check passed)
